'''Operation Foe-smasher''' was an [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] operation carried out during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It saw the Sith Empire [[Battle in the Cha Raaba system|prevent]] the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Varek Tarn]] from selling the plans of the [[Sovereign Forge]] in the [[Cha Raaba system]], and also [[Attack on Duma's forces|wipe out]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Duma]]'s forces.
